title: Simple Craft Enchanting table
description: This mod replaces obsidian in the enchantment table crafting with cobblestone.
body: When Notch first added the enchantment table to Minecraft, he decided that cobblestone would be used in the crafting process, but later he replaced it with obsidian to make it more difficult to obtain. This mod adds cobblestone to the crafting process, allowing you to craft the table in the early stages of the game.
